name: theatre-production-manager-rules-tests
description: Automated Firestore security rules tests for Theatre Production Manager

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-venue-rules-tests --only firestore "npx mocha test/firestore.rules.test.js --timeout 15000"
scripts.test:bookings: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-venue-booking-tests --only auth,firestore,functions "npm --prefix functions test"
scripts.test: npm run test:functions:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:bookings
